newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iran raises Dec Light crude by 15 cts/bbl-traders.
newsitem.headline: Iran raises Dec Light crude by 15 cts/bbl-traders.

text.p: State-owned National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC) has raised its crude pricing formula for Iranian Light crude by 15 cents a barrel for December loading for Asian customers, traders said on Monday.
Following the hike, Iranian Light for December loading will be priced at Oman's MPM plus three cents, with an automatic adjustment factor added to that.
Iran kept the formula for Iranian Heavy unchanged at Dubai quotations minus three cents per barrel, with an automatic adjustment factor then subtracted.
Iranian crude price formulas are set on a quarterly basis.
However, under a contract agreement, NIOC and customers can review prices whenever the market moves substantially.
